scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npx playwright install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd ad-server && npm install && cd ../client-app && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project softomedia-demo --only firestore,storage "npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath tests/firestore-rules/rules.test.js"
scripts.test:demo-reset: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project softomedia-demo --only auth,firestore,storage "cd ad-server && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --coverage=false tests/demo-reset.integration.test.js"
scripts.test:media-emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project softomedia-demo --only auth,firestore,storage "cross-env NODE_ENV=test MEDIA_EMULATOR_TEST=true GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=softomedia-demo DEMO_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo DEMO_ASSETS_BUCKET=softomedia-demo.firebasestorage.app FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8090 STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:9199 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9099 npm run test:media:http && npm run test:media:browser"
scripts.test:brand:browser: cross-env NODE_ENV=test MEDIA_EMULATOR_TEST=true GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=softomedia-demo FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo DEMO_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo DEMO_ASSETS_BUCKET=softomedia-demo.firebasestorage.app VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9099 playwright test tests/brand_campaign.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:brand-emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project softomedia-demo --only auth,firestore,storage "cross-env NODE_ENV=test MEDIA_EMULATOR_TEST=true GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=softomedia-demo FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo DEMO_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo DEMO_ASSETS_BUCKET=softomedia-demo.firebasestorage.app FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8090 STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:9199 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=softomedia-demo VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9099 npm run test:brand:http && npm run test:brand:browser"
scripts.lint: node scripts/lint-tests.js && cd ad-server && npm run lint && cd ../client-app && npm run lint
